# Surface tools

surface.ui_list reports this workspace's panels, viewer dimensions and focus; surface.ui_get inspects a panel. This is workspace state, not the complete fleet Stage. Read the schemas and props guide before using surface.ui_show/ui_update. Update existing stable IDs instead of duplicating panels. Use height "fill" for a single app or presentation; build layouts that remain usable on phone and desktop. surface.ui_html and surface.ui_app create interactive content; surface.ui_screenshot verifies its appearance. Respect removed/hidden panels and shared expanded focus.

For every presentation, use a Surface HTML/app deck with height "fill". Register window.surface.presentation.register({id:"stable-deck-id",count:steps.length,render:index=>showStep(index)}). Include fragment reveals in steps. The runtime supplies phone-sized Previous/Next controls, swipe, keyboard navigation and shared presenter position. render only paints; route custom navigation through the returned next(), previous(), go(index). Never promise keyboard-only navigation. Verify phone and presenter advance together. Arbitrary app-local input and scrolling do not synchronize automatically.
